name: THE MAN LEAVING TOMORROW
note: Doc 07 #7. 'Outside the hotel. Has been leaving tomorrow for four years. Arcs.' He stands in the mud just east of the hotel's door with his bag, which he has been about to pick up for four years (errata 110).
